descriptions.grade: Define risk and default control strength.
descriptions.sensitiveDataType: Define sensitive data that must be detected and protected.
descriptions.protectionBaseline: Define minimum protection for a sensitive type and grade.
descriptions.protectionEnrollment: Select Meta-scanned data resources for protection and inspect the actual protection state at each data outlet.

enrollment.releaseStarted: Protection removal started; existing protection remains until every outlet confirms
enrollment.releaseWarning: After completion, Security rules no longer protect this resource. Existing protection remains until every outlet confirms.
enrollment.releaseReason: Explain why protection is being stopped
enrollment.confirmNoProtectionNeeded: Confirm no protection is currently needed
enrollment.noFindingsReleaseWarning: The latest discovery completed with no candidates found by currently supported detectors. This does not prove that the resource contains no other sensitive information. Review its business meaning before stopping protection.
enrollment.noFindingsReleaseReason: Describe the business review and why protection is currently unnecessary
enrollment.createHint: Select a complete resource and Security will discover sensitive fields automatically. No fingerprint or field path is required.
enrollment.itemLoadFailed: Failed to load data resource details
enrollment.alreadyEnrolled: This data resource is already protected
enrollment.empty: No protected resources. Select one of the resources already scanned by Meta.

emptyStates.current: No resources are currently protected. Select one of the resources already scanned by Meta.

enrollment.wholeResourceScope: Complete data resource; sensitive fields are discovered automatically
enrollment.autoRefreshTimedOut: Processing is taking longer than expected. Automatic updates were paused; refresh manually or open execution monitoring.
enrollment.discoveryNotCompletedTitle: No successful sensitive discovery is available
enrollment.discoveryNotCompletedDescription: Baseline protection remains in force. A zero-finding release cannot be confirmed before discovery completes.
enrollment.discoveryZeroFindingsTitle: Currently supported detectors found no sensitive-field candidates
enrollment.discoveryZeroFindingsDescription: This only means the latest successful discovery had zero findings; it does not prove that no other sensitive information exists. Review the business meaning.
enrollment.discoveryFindingCountDescription: {count} candidates still require review. Candidates above the protection threshold are already conservatively protected.
enrollment.discoveryReviewCompletedTitle: All {count} candidates in the current snapshot were reviewed
enrollment.discoveryReviewCompletedDescription: Reviews are immutable. Confirmed or adjusted candidates formed formal assessments, while rejected candidates were resolved through the same projection change flow.

stateDescriptions.activating: Syncing the initial protection requirements to each data outlet
stateDescriptions.enrolling: Data outlets do not return this resource while sensitive fields are identified or field protection rules are pending
stateDescriptions.partiallyActive: Field-level protection is active at {count} data outlets
stateDescriptions.active: Every required outlet enforces field-level protection
stateDescriptions.releasing: Existing protection remains until every outlet confirms
stateDescriptions.released: Security protection has been removed from every outlet

enrollment.ownerEffectWaiting: The current protection requirements have not reached this data outlet
enrollment.ownerEffectDeniedPendingRule: No executable field rule is available yet, so the enrollment baseline conservatively denies this outlet
enrollment.ownerEffectDeniedUnsupported: This outlet does not yet have a field-level protection executor, so the enrollment baseline conservatively denies it
enrollment.ownerEffectActive: Effective field protection rules are enforced

finding.currentSnapshotHint: Only candidates from the latest successful discovery are shown. Historical snapshots remain auditable but are not mixed into current work.
finding.currentSnapshotEmpty: No candidates are available for the current snapshot
finding.adjustmentRequired: Select both a sensitive data type and security grade when adjusting
finding.loadDefinitionsFailed: Failed to load classification and grade definitions

rationalePlaceholders.confirm: Describe the field's business meaning and confirmation basis
rationalePlaceholders.adjust: Describe the adjusted type, grade, and business basis
rationalePlaceholders.reject: Explain why this candidate is a false positive

evidenceRules.terminalFieldName: Terminal field name matched; field type: {type}
evidenceRules.exactDigitRun: {count} format-conforming candidates were observed in a controlled sample (raw values are not stored)
evidenceRules.detectorMatch: Detector rule matched (raw sensitive values are not stored)
